mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meridian_model_progress (id,user_id,completed_slots,total_slots,progress_percent,progress_note,updated_at) VALUES (CAST((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW(3)) * 1000000 + FLOOR(RAND() * 1000000)) AS UNSIGNED),#{userId},#{completedSlots},#{totalSlots},#{progressPercent},#{progressNote},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed_slots=VALUES(completed_slots),total_slots=VALUES(total_slots),progress_percent=VALUES(progress_percent),progress_note=VALUES(progress_note),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM meridian_model_progress WHERE user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
